success: Your gambit lands cleanly; {actor} looks genuinely impressed.
Everything falls into place. The moment is yours.
It works better than you dared hope.
A confident move, and the world bends your way.
failure: It goes wrong. {actor} narrows their eyes.
The attempt falters, and the moment slips from your grasp.
Not your finest hour. The consequences begin to gather.
A stumble. Somewhere, someone takes note.
crit_success: A flawless stroke: even fate seems to applaud.
It couldn't have gone better if it had been scripted.
crit_failure: Disaster. If there was a wrong way to do it, you found it spectacularly.
Everything that could go wrong, does.
combat_start: Steel rings and shadows lunge from the dark.
The air tightens; a fight is unavoidable.
Weapons are drawn. No one is leaving without a scar.
victory: The last foe falls. Silence returns, ragged breaths and the smell of iron.
Victory. The echoes of battle fade into the trees.
defeat: Darkness rushes in at the edges of your vision.
You fall, and the world goes quiet.

combat: Movement flickers in the gloom ahead.
You hear whispering and the scrape of steel.
elite: A heavy silence. Whatever waits here is bigger than the rest.
event: Something strange waits in the next chamber.
treasure: A faint glitter catches your eye.
trap: The floor looks wrong. Too clean.
puzzle: The air hums with old, patient magic.
lore: Dust and old words fill this quiet room.
rest: A sheltered corner, warm enough for a fire.
merchant: A lantern swings; a trader hums to himself.
smith: The ring of a hammer on an anvil, impossibly cheerful.
prisoner: A shape moves behind iron bars.
secret: Behind the false wall, a hidden chamber.
boss: The heart of the place. Something old turns to look at you.
social: A figure watches you from the shadows, waiting.

travel: The road is long, but the world is wide and full of surprises.
rest: The fire crackles. For a while, the world is small and warm.
You sleep, and the dreams are only mildly cursed.
hallucination: The trees melt into rippling rainbows and the enemy's face keeps changing.
The ground sings. Everything is slightly too bright.
ability: {actor} unleashes {action} in a burst of colour.

goblin: Cackling and covered in stolen jewelry.
A rusty blade and a rustier temper.
bandit: Scarred knuckles and a hungry grin.
undead: Dust and cold fire in empty sockets.
It remembers being alive, and resents you.
elemental: A restless shape of living energy.
construct: Gears and grit and zero mercy.
rift: A rip in reality wearing a shape.
Its outline refuses to stay still.
default: A dangerous foe blocks your path.

rumors: Folk say the old road is haunted after dark.
A trader swears he saw a goblin wearing a crown of spoons.
Someone is paying handsomely for bandit ears.
The Guild is hiding something about the missing caravans.
A star fell in the south. Folk there aren't sleeping well.

encounters.name: Moss-Backed Wolf
encounters.desc: A wolf with moss-slick fur pads from the undergrowth.

encounters.name: Crystal Spider
encounters.desc: A jagged spider that chimes as it moves.

encounters.name: Ember Hound
encounters.desc: Smoke curls from its snarling jaws.
